description: This PHP class `ThemeService` provides functionality for managing theme-related assets and variables within the OrangeHRM application, including caching, retrieving images and their ETags, generating CSS variables, and constructing URLs for theme assets.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: Provides methods to manage theme assets, variables, and cache for the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getThemeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ThemeDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getScssHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of ScssHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getImageETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for a given theme image key from cache.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the ThemeImage object for a given key, using cache.

methods.name: getImageETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Fetches image and ETag, caching both, for a given key.

methods.name: getCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns the CSS variables for the current theme, caching the result.

methods.name: showSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Determines if social media icons should be shown based on theme.

methods.name: getDerivedCssVariables
methods.description: Generates a map of CSS variables based on theme variables, including color manipulations.

methods.name: getClientLogoURL
methods.description: Builds URL for client logo image, considering cache and default fallback.

methods.name: getClientBannerURL
methods.description: Builds URL for client banner image, considering cache and default fallback.

methods.name: getLoginBannerURL
methods.description: Builds URL for login banner image, considering cache and default fallback.
